title: NAS security mode command accepted by the UE

entities.name: Security Mode Command Acceptance
entities.description: UE procedure for accepting SECURITY MODE COMMAND message by performing integrity check and verifying replayed security parameters.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMMAND
entities.description: Network-initiated message to establish NAS security context.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMPLETE
entities.description: UE response message confirming security mode establishment, integrity protected and ciphered.

entities.name: NAS key set identifier
entities.description: IE carrying KSI/eKSI and type of security context flag.

entities.name: UE security capabilities
entities.description: Replayed UE security capabilities from SECURITY MODE COMMAND.

entities.name: nonceUE
entities.description: Nonce value sent by UE, replayed in SECURITY MODE COMMAND.

entities.name: IMEISV
entities.description: International Mobile Equipment Identity and Software Version number.

entities.name: UE radio capability ID
entities.description: Identifier for UE radio capabilities, either network-assigned or manufacturer-assigned.

entities.name: Replayed NAS message container
entities.description: Container for replayed ATTACH REQUEST or TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

entities.name: Emergency bearer services condition
entities.description: Condition where UE has PDN connection for emergency bearer services or is attaching for RLOS.

entities.name: EIA0 acceptable condition
entities.description: Condition where null integrity algorithm EIA0 is acceptable only for emergency services.

entities.name: Uplink NAS COUNT reset
entities.description: Property where UE resets uplink NAS COUNT under specific conditions.

entities.name: Downlink NAS COUNT setting
entities.description: Property where UE sets downlink NAS COUNT based on integrity check result.

entities.name: EPS security context activation
entities.description: Property where UE takes EPS security context into use and deletes old contexts.

relations.description: Procedure triggered by receipt of SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.
Procedure results in sending SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND contains NAS key set identifier IE.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND contains replayed UE security capabilities.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND may contain nonceUE.
Emergency bearer services condition guards acceptance of EIA0.
Procedure establishes uplink NAS COUNT reset under conditions.
Procedure establishes downlink NAS COUNT setting based on integrity check.
Procedure establishes activation of new EPS security context.
SECURITY MODE COMPLETE contains IMEISV if requested.
SECURITY MODE COMPLETE contains UE radio capability ID if requested in WB-S1 mode.
SECURITY MODE COMPLETE contains replayed NAS message container if HASHMME mismatch.
SECURITY MODE COMPLETE requires integrity protection and ciphering with new security context.
